GP practices in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly

Source: R/data_cornwall.R
cornwall_gp.Rd

The 55 general practices of NHS Cornwall and Isles of Scilly Integrated Care Board (ICB code QT6) with their GP workforce and registered lists. Use gp_fte_extg as supply in examples: it excludes GPs in training, whose recording changed in June 2018 and who cluster in training practices.

Usage

cornwall_gp

Format

An sf point object (EPSG:27700, British National Grid) with 55 rows and columns:

practice

NHS ODS practice code; matches cornwall_flows, the columns of cornwall_travel and the layers of cornwall_gp_travel.tif.

name, postcode, pcn

Practice name, main-site postcode and Primary Care Network.

gp_fte_extg

Full-time equivalent GPs excluding GPs in training (1 FTE = 37.5 hours a week).

gp_fte

All GPs, including GPs in training and locums.

gp_fte_extgl

GPs excluding GPs in training and locums.

nurse_fte

Full-time equivalent nurses (may be NA).

list_size

Registered patients from all areas.

list_in_area

Registered patients living in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly.

fte_source

Whether the workforce record includes estimates.

scilly

TRUE for the practice on the Isles of Scilly.

geometry

Main-site location from the postcode.

Source

NHS England, Patients Registered at a GP Practice (July 2026) and General Practice Workforce (30 June 2026), Open Government Licence v3.0. Locations from the ONS Postcode Directory (November 2025). See system.file("COPYRIGHTS", package = "spax").

Details

Registrations are a July 2026 snapshot and workforce a June 2026 snapshot. Only the main site of each practice is represented; branch surgeries are not.

See also

cornwall_lsoa, cornwall_flows, cornwall_travel, cornwall_gp_travel

Examples

gp <- sf::st_drop_geometry(cornwall_gp)
head(gp[, c("practice", "name", "gp_fte_extg", "list_size")])
#>   practice                                name gp_fte_extg list_size
#> 1   L82001             LANDER MEDICAL PRACTICE   10.298887     19477
#> 2   L82003                  PORT ISAAC SURGERY    4.693333      8738
#> 3   L82004 WADEBRIDGE & CAMEL ESTUARY PRACTICE    4.341333      8045
#> 4   L82006                      PENRYN SURGERY    7.973333     20089
#> 5   L82007            CAMELFORD MEDICAL CENTRE    2.888800      6658
#> 6   L82008             STRATTON MEDICAL CENTRE    4.670400     10746
# Registered patients per GP FTE (excluding GPs in training)
summary(gp$list_size / gp$gp_fte_extg)
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#>   247.9  1587.9  1866.9  2069.2  2244.9  7515.9
